scope.restriction: One targeted review against C01-C07 and author revision log. Correct single-source details, source completeness and actual clinical/language error are distinct. Low-risk history organization is not subjected to a two-source clinical-efficacy requirement.

findings.issue: The English grammar can attach prevents usual activities to fever as well as illness, while Chinese and NHS retain fever alone as one branch.
findings.required_change: Make English conditions explicitly disjunctive, e.g. Reduce contact with others when you have a fever or feel too unwell to do your usual activities. Preserve the equivalent Chinese condition.

findings.issue: Specific single-source or partial-scope details remain as enumerated per claim. They are not declared medically false and do not justify erasing useful warnings.
findings.required_change: For the promised fully cross-checked designation, obtain independent matching support for key action/risk/threshold subclauses or retain an explicit unresolved status. Explanation-only and diary-format details require adequate support/provenance, not automatic dual sources.

old_findings_disposition.result: Clinical omission fixed in red_flags-3 and daily_care-3; specific NHS-only details remain a completeness issue, not recurrence of the dangerous omission.
Fixed: overall severe illness wording now matches in both languages.
Major binding repairs verified. Mechanism/precision gaps listed per claim; practical diary and appointment organization accepted without rigid dual-source requirement.
Several actions now independently supported. Exact single-source thresholds/scopes retained transparently; article cannot yet be labeled fully cross-checked.
Antibiotic risks and duplicate-ingredient/pregnancy advice materially repaired. Literal adult-product restriction scope remains attributed rather than fabricated as identical wording.
benefit/risk classifications corrected; chronic-impact list independently supported except explicit muscle-soreness detail.
Adult reflux restriction and infant-fever route correct; distinct duration purposes preserved. Minor age/population support gaps remain explicit.

source_independence.NHS: National NHS pages are one authoring group; CUH dietitian material is locally authored, but is not combined with NHS to fake two-source support here.
source_independence.Healthdirect: Own writing with NHS/RCH/BMJ/NSW and other upstream references disclosed; different prose is not independent trial replication.
source_independence.Mayo_ALA: Each institution’s multiple pages count once.
source_independence.NIH: NHLBI and NIDDK are separate topic teams under NIH; no claim uses their pair alone to manufacture independent evidence.
source_independence.NICE: Guideline and evidence summary count once. Direct403 and official indexed access distinguished.
source_independence.ADAM: Physician-reviewed A.D.A.M. encyclopedia hosted by MedlinePlus is not NIH-authored public-domain content.

questions: causes_risks-2: exact secretion-carried-pathogen mechanism still lacks two located independent passages; bound CDC/Healthdirect support spread prevention rather than this wording.

red_flags-3: exact more-than-few-spots, isolated upper-back pain and rapid-heartbeat criteria are NHS-specific; Mayo/Healthdirect directly support larger/persistent bleeding and chest pain/breathlessness.
red_flags-4: urgent consultation is explicit NHS; NICE supports significant/systemic worsening but not identical same-day timing for each symptom.
care-3: NHS directly supports weak-immunity contact; NICE risk stratification does not set identical contact timing. Recurrent episodes are direct CDC bronchitis advice, not all causes.
differentials-3: exact pneumothorax sudden-pain/breathlessness pair is ALA direct; second sources cover serious-cause assessment, not every named pair.
treatment-3: NICE full acute bronchodilator/steroid exception rule lacks fully matching independent adult support; RCH is pediatric empirical-steroid guidance only.
medications-4: FDA explicitly prohibits adult-packaged medicines for children; HSA requires appropriate child formulation/strength but not the identical blanket prohibition.
diet-2: small-child hot-drink avoidance is directly NHS only in bound material. Honey evidence is short-term symptom relief, not proven shortened illness; NICE/RCH evidence and wording differ.
special_populations-2: infant under-3-month cough without fever is direct ADAM alone; fever at 38C has CDC/NHS. Keep criteria distinct.
special_populations-3: renal-disease-specific acute-cough risk is direct NICE; CDC explicitly covers heart/lung/immune restriction, not renal disease.
complications-2: sleep/fatigue/vomiting/leakage independently supported; exact muscle-soreness description is ALA, Healthdirect instead names chest/back pain.
prevention-2: hygiene/air/vaccines and staying home have independent writing; exact fever/usual-activity threshold remains NHS-specific. Healthdirect cites NHS/RCH background.

release_recommendation: Apply CR01 as a narrow bilingual fix and retain unresolved support status for the promised complete cross-check standard. No clinical signoff or ICD coverage upgrade. Do not repeat unchanged accepted review or delete correct single-source safety conditions merely to remove gaps.
license_handling: Stores hashes, short locators and original review judgements; no full source text, tables or images redistributed.
